name: increment
description: Increase the counter by a positive amount. Use for: add, plus, increase, more, higher, count up.

amount.description: Positive amount to increase the counter by (e.g., 1, 5, 100)

name: decrement
description: Decrease the counter by a positive amount. Use for: subtract, minus, decrease, less, lower, reduce, take away.

amount.description: Positive amount to decrease the counter by (e.g., 1, 5, 100). The tool internally applies the negative sign.
